layers.scope_label: Ensemble diagnostic · shared by all conformers
layers.label: Legacy RPF heat index
layers.definition: Original ASDP web/Jmol precision heat projection: symmetric unsupported inter-residue interaction pairs, excluding atom H, weighted by 15000 × distance^-6 / 2 per direction after native ambiguity and spectrum-key collapsing.

layers.scope_label: Ensemble diagnostic · shared by all conformers
layers.label: Precision violation groups
layers.definition: Number of native directed unsupported-interaction groups involving the residue; count each group once per residue, regardless of alternative atom-pair count.

layers.scope_label: Ensemble diagnostic · shared by all conformers
layers.label: Short violations (<3 Å)
layers.definition: Reported unsupported-interaction groups involving the residue whose native printed effective group distance is strictly below 3 Å.

layers.scope_label: Ensemble diagnostic · shared by all conformers
layers.label: Shortest unsupported distance
layers.definition: Minimum native printed effective distance among unsupported-interaction groups involving the residue; unavailable when no group is reported.

provenance.color_semantics: Legacy RPF heat index uses the original Web/Rasmol.pm piecewise RGB formula and thresholds. Count/distance layers use an explicitly separate blue-white-red browser palette.
limitations: No residue-wise Recall, Precision fraction or DP is inferred.
Direction and spectrum multiplicities are retained; these are reported groups, not unique undirected contacts.
Unassigned-proton residues are unavailable rather than zero. A zero means no reported group, not proof of complete experimental coverage.
The multi-model QP report is ensemble-level and cannot distinguish individual conformers.
